configureAttributes.heading: Attributes
configureAttributes.description: Attributes are scoped to a single workflow (1:1) -- pick one to edit its declared schema. Decision edges in that workflow evaluate against these fields.

requestSummary.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes "{{label}}". This cannot be undone.
requestSummary.noSchemaDeclared: No schema declared for this request.

configureLists.heading: Lists
configureLists.label: Label
configureLists.addColumnFirst: Add at least one column, then Save, to start adding rows.
configureLists.emptyDescription: A reusable typed dataset a workflow's List Search (or List Lookup) node can resolve against.
configureLists.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes "{{label}}". This cannot be undone.

profileCaption.clean: Fail-safe default -- no shell startup files are sourced; the step sees only the variables below.
profileCaption.login: Sources the shell's login startup files (.zprofile / .bash_profile) in addition to the variables below -- terminal parity, less deterministic.

configureExecEnv.heading: Execution Environments
configureExecEnv.label: Label
configureExecEnv.workingDirectoryCaption: Use {{sentinel}} to mint a fresh, Mill-owned temp directory for each run, or a real absolute path.
configureExecEnv.environmentVariablesCaption: Explicit only -- never inherits Mill's own environment. Leave empty for a minimal default PATH.
configureExecEnv.emptyDescription: A reusable, pinned shell/directory/env a code-execution workflow node can run inside.
configureExecEnv.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes "{{label}}". This cannot be undone.

configureDecisions.heading: Decisions
configureDecisions.pageDescription: A Decision is a reusable, typed TERMINAL outcome -- a workflow's Decision node reaches one of these to end the run with a real category and typed result, instead of just running out of steps.
configureDecisions.label: Label
configureDecisions.categoryCaptionEditing: Cannot be changed after creation -- duplicate this Decision to create one with a different category.
configureDecisions.categoryCaptionCreating: Cannot be changed after creation -- duplicate this Decision later to create one with a different category.
configureDecisions.outputsDescription: This Decision's typed result fields -- what a workflow's decision-outcome node binds values into when it reaches this outcome.
configureDecisions.webhookDescription: Fires this HTTPRequest with the outcome's outputs as its body when this Decision is reached. External calls ask for approval by default, same as an Integration step.
configureDecisions.emptyDescription: A reusable, typed TERMINAL outcome a workflow's Decision node reaches to end the run.
configureDecisions.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes "{{label}}". This cannot be undone.

configureMCPServers.heading: MCP Servers
configureMCPServers.label: Label
configureMCPServers.commandCaption: Run over stdio, e.g. a locally installed MCP server binary.
configureMCPServers.emptyDescription: A reusable stdio connection an mcp-tool-call workflow node can resolve by ID.
configureMCPServers.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes "{{label}}". This cannot be undone.

configureAIProviders.heading: AI Providers
configureAIProviders.label: Label
configureAIProviders.baseUrlCaptionAnthropic: Leave empty to use the real Anthropic API (api.anthropic.com).
configureAIProviders.baseUrlCaptionOther: e.g. http://localhost:11434 for local Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
configureAIProviders.secretCaption: Write-only -- never shown again after saving. Leave empty for a local, unauthenticated endpoint (e.g. Ollama).
configureAIProviders.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes "{{label}}". This cannot be undone.
configureAIProviders.emptyDescription: A reusable connection to local Ollama or a BYO OpenAI-compatible/Anthropic endpoint an AI workflow step can resolve by ID.

entityRefField.noCallableWorkflowsHint: No callable workflows yet — create a workflow whose trigger is "callable by another workflow" (drag that trigger from the palette onto a new workflow's canvas), then pick it here.
entityRefField.label: Label
entityRefField.categoryCaption: Cannot be changed after creation -- duplicate this Decision to create one with a different category.
entityRefField.baseUrlCaptionAnthropic: Leave empty to use the real Anthropic API.

manualSchemaEditor.methodTooltip: The request's own Method (set at the top of this form) -- the schema only describes the payload, never the transport.
manualSchemaEditor.inputDescription: The attributes this request accepts. Parameters first (path / query / header -- how the call is addressed over HTTP), then the request body (the payload itself).
manualSchemaEditor.outputDescription: The attributes this request's response provides -- what a workflow node can read out of the response and bind into its own Attributes.
manualSchemaEditor.secretCaption: A secret output can never be mapped into a workflow Attribute (ValidateGraph rejects it at save time -- ADR-0007's guardrail).
manualSchemaEditor.aliasCaption: Optional friendlier name shown in binding editors instead of the wire name.
manualSchemaEditor.extractPathCaption: Optional dot-path into nested response JSON, e.g. data.name.
manualSchemaEditor.allowedValuesCaption: Optional, comma-separated (an enum). Plain text input, not Primer's TextInputWithTokens -- that component is deprecated in the installed version (checked directly, ADR-0011).

requestTestPanel.mustBeJsonObject: Must be a JSON object, e.g. {"id": "123"}.
requestTestPanel.declareSchemaFirst: Declare a Schema first (Schema tab) -- testing needs at least one operation.
requestTestPanel.noOperationsYet: The Schema tab doesn't declare any operations yet.

configureRequests.restApiRequestDescription: Call an external HTTP API — typed request/response schema, auth, headers.
configureRequests.heading: Integrations
configureRequests.emptyDescription: Call an external HTTP API with a typed request/response schema, auth, and headers.

requestAuthSections.notYetImplementedDescription: This auth type is registered (docs/adr/0015) but its strategy isn't built yet -- a workflow run through this request will fail with a clear error rather than a guessed signature. Selectable now so the request can be configured ahead of that work landing.
requestAuthSections.scopeCaption: Optional -- leave blank to request no specific scope.
requestAuthSections.signatureHeaderCaption: Defaults to X-Signature when left blank.
requestAuthSections.secretCaption: Write-only -- stored in the OS keychain, never readable back through Mill.
requestAuthSections.leaveBlankToKeepSecret: Leave blank to keep the existing secret.
requestAuthSections.tokenSecretCaption: Optional -- omit for 2-legged OAuth 1.0a, same as Token above.
requestAuthSections.joseDescription: Optional, independent of Auth type above (Phase 3, ADR-0015) -- encrypts what Mill sends to this request, and optionally decrypts what it receives back (JWE, RFC 7516).
requestAuthSections.recipientPublicKeyCaption: The vendor's RSA public key -- used to encrypt the outgoing request body. Not a secret.
requestAuthSections.decryptResponseLabel: Decrypt response (this request's replies are also JWE-encrypted)
requestAuthSections.millsPrivateKeyCaption: Write-only -- stored in the OS keychain, separately from the Auth secret above, never readable back through Mill.
requestAuthSections.leaveBlankToKeepKey: Leave blank to keep the existing key.

requestForm.label: Label
requestForm.urlCaption: The complete URL this integration calls -- path included, one place ({{brace}}param{{closeBrace}} templates welcome, bound via the Schema's path parameters).
requestForm.bodyCaption: Optional -- a raw request body sent as-is (e.g. fixed JSON). If the Schema below declares body fields and a workflow binds them, the bound body wins; this is the fallback. Lives here, not on the workflow node: transport and payload shape are the integration's own.
requestForm.descriptionCaption: Optional -- what this request is for, or any caveat worth noting.
requestForm.headersDescription: Static headers (e.g. a required API version) sent with every call, in addition to whatever the Auth type adds.
requestForm.schemaDescription: The payload's structure only -- typed input/output fields a workflow node can bind Attributes to (ADR-0007). Method and URL live above; they are never part of the schema. Leave empty to keep using a literal request body.
requestForm.multiOperationNote: This request's stored schema declares {{count}} operations. A Mill request is one call (1:1 with its operation) -- remove the extras below, or Duplicate the request once per operation.

openapiSynth.notValidJsonSwitchBack: Not valid JSON -- switch back to "Paste OpenAPI" to edit as YAML or fix the JSON first.

schemaIntake.nothingToLoad: Nothing to load -- paste content or drop a file first.
schemaIntake.noOperationsDeclared: The OpenAPI document declares no operations.
schemaIntake.unrecognizedFormat: Couldn't recognize this as OpenAPI JSON, a JSON sample, or CSV{{detail}}. CSV needs a header row: path,method,direction,name,in,type,required,secret,alias,extractPath.
schemaIntake.inferredFieldsNotice: Inferred {{count}} field{{plural}} from the JSON sample -- review below.
schemaIntake.textareaPlaceholder: Paste an OpenAPI document, a JSON sample payload, or CSV field rows here -- or drop a .json/.csv file.

pasteSample.pasteJsonObject: Paste a JSON object (e.g. {"name": "..."}), not an array or a bare value.
pasteSample.noFieldsFound: No fields found in the pasted sample.
